prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Brandon Hornsby of Hornsby Law Group
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every car accident case. A good choice depends on the severity of your injuries, the evidence, and whether the case may need to go to trial.

One Atlanta attorney to consider is **Brandon Hornsby of Hornsby Law Group**. His Super Lawyers profile lists motor-vehicle accidents, plaintiff personal injury, and wrongful-death work, and says he is a former state and federal prosecutor. That’s a starting point, not an endorsement or a guarantee of results. [Profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/georgia/atlanta/lawyer/brandon-hornsby/09e27320-7dd4-49d9-9e63-f48490b5e96c.html)

Before hiring anyone, speak with two or three firms and ask:
- Who will personally handle my case?
- What experience do you have with cases like mine, including trials?
- What is the contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe?
- How often will I get updates, and who will be my contact?

You can also browse the [State Bar of Georgia’s lawyer directory](https://www.gabar.org/public/find-a-lawyer) or contact the Atlanta Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral and Information Service at **404-521-0777**. The State Bar notes that it does not endorse or certify referral services.
